items.title: Microsoft Entra ID Introduces Continuous Access Evaluation for High-Risk Sessions
items.summary: Microsoft has expanded Continuous Access Evaluation (CAE) to cover high-risk sign-in sessions, enabling near real-time policy enforcement without requiring re-authentication. The update allows organizations to revoke access tokens within seconds of detecting anomalous behaviour, closing the window attackers exploit between token issuance and expiry.

items.title: CISA Issues Emergency Directive on Okta Cross-Tenant Impersonation Vulnerability
items.summary: CISA has issued an emergency directive requiring federal agencies to apply mitigations for a critical vulnerability in Okta's cross-tenant authentication flow that could allow attackers to impersonate users across organizational boundaries. The flaw affects Okta Classic Engine deployments and is rated CVSS 9.1.

items.title: Passkey Adoption Surges Past 1 Billion Accounts as Google and Apple Expand Support
items.summary: The FIDO Alliance reports passkey adoption has crossed 1 billion accounts globally, driven by expanded platform support from Google and Apple. Enterprises are increasingly deploying passkeys as a replacement for SMS OTP, with phishing resistance and reduced helpdesk load cited as primary motivators. WebAuthn Level 3 specification is expected to finalise by Q3 2026.

items.title: SailPoint Acquires Identity Governance Startup to Bolster AI-Driven Access Reviews
items.summary: SailPoint has announced the acquisition of a startup specialising in AI-powered access certification workflows, aiming to reduce the time spent on access reviews by 70%. The integration will allow SailPoint IdentityNow to surface anomalous role assignments and auto-certify low-risk access without human review, while escalating high-risk entitlements.

items.title: CyberArk Privilege Cloud Update Extends PAM to Cloud-Native Workloads
items.summary: CyberArk has released a major update to Privilege Cloud that extends privileged access management to Kubernetes service accounts, AWS IAM roles, and Azure managed identities. The update introduces automated secret rotation for cloud-native workloads and adds JIT access capabilities for ephemeral compute environments, reducing standing privilege across hybrid infrastructure.

items.title: North Korean Threat Actors Exploit SAML Assertion Forgery in Supply Chain Attack
items.summary: Security researchers have attributed a sophisticated supply chain attack to Lazarus Group, leveraging SAML assertion forgery to pivot from a compromised IdP into downstream SaaS applications. The attack bypassed MFA by hijacking federated sessions post-authentication, affecting an estimated 40 enterprise customers of a major SSO provider.

items.title: NIST SP 800-207A Draft: Zero Trust Architecture for Multi-Cloud Environments
items.summary: NIST has published a draft of SP 800-207A extending the original Zero Trust Architecture guidance to address multi-cloud and hybrid deployments. The new draft introduces a cloud-agnostic policy decision point (PDP) model and provides reference architectures for identity-centric zero trust across AWS, Azure, and GCP simultaneously. Public comment period closes July 15.

items.title: Auth0 Launches Fine-Grained Authorization Engine in General Availability
items.summary: Okta's Auth0 has moved its Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) engine into general availability, enabling developers to implement relationship-based access control (ReBAC) at scale. The service is based on Google Zanzibar and supports up to 100M permission checks per second, with SDKs available for Node.js, Python, Go, and Java. Pricing starts at $0.001 per 1,000 checks.

items.title: EU eIDAS 2.0 Digital Identity Wallet: Implementation Deadline Approaches for Member States
items.summary: European Union member states face a deadline to begin rollout of eIDAS 2.0-compliant digital identity wallets by Q4 2026. The regulation mandates that citizens can use government-issued digital identities for online public and private sector services. Industry groups warn that interoperability between national wallet implementations remains a significant unsolved challenge.

items.title: Scattered Spider Returns: Social Engineering Targets Identity Provider Help Desks
items.summary: The Scattered Spider threat group has resumed targeting enterprise identity provider help desks using AI-generated voice deepfakes to bypass identity verification and trigger SIM swaps and MFA resets. At least six Fortune 500 companies were targeted in May 2026. Security teams are advised to implement callback verification with out-of-band authentication for all identity resets.

items.title: Ping Identity Unveils Neo: Agentic AI Identity Platform for Autonomous Access Decisions
items.summary: Ping Identity has announced Neo, an agentic AI platform that makes autonomous, context-aware access decisions in real time. Neo analyses user behaviour, device posture, network context, and peer-group norms to dynamically adjust session privileges without requiring static policy rules. Early access is available to existing PingOne customers.

items.title: CVE-2026-29113 — Active Directory Certificate Services EKU Bypass Allows Domain Escalation
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Active Directory Certificate Services allows attackers with standard domain user privileges to request certificates with arbitrary Extended Key Usages, enabling full domain compromise. The flaw affects all Windows Server versions with ADCS deployed. Microsoft released an out-of-band patch; CISA has added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
